description: Hyperliquid perps ranked by how their open interest moved over the last 1h, 4h, 24h or 7d: open interest at the start and now (in coins), the change in USD at the latest mark and in percent. Sorted by the size of the USD change by default, or by percent. Filter to one HIP-3 dex (xyz) or to native perps only. Markets with less than $100k of open interest at both ends are left out unless you lower min_oi_usd. Use it for 'where is money flowing in or out'. For one market's latest open interest use get_open_interest.

dex.description: Optional: a HIP-3 dex such as xyz, or native for validator-run perps

min_oi_usd.description: Leave out markets below this open interest in USD (default 100000)

sort.description: Rank by USD change (default) or percent change

name: get_open_interest_changes

outputSchema.description: Perps ranked by open interest change

change_usd.description: Change in USD at the latest mark

dex.description: HIP-3 dex, e.g. "xyz" (absent for native perps)

oi_start.description: Open interest at the window start, in coins

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: Open interest movers
